results.scenario: explain_metric documents the formula
results.question: explain how moving fraction is calculated
results.actual: moving_fraction (moving-fraction-v1): Fraction of observed freight vessels with a reported speed above the moving threshold. Vessels with missing speed data are excluded, never counted as stopped (missing is not zero). Current value: 0.9090909090909091 fraction.
